package postgres

import "fmt"

type tbl struct{ Schema, Table, Name string }

func unsafeConcat(t tbl) string { return "SELECT * FROM " + t.Schema + "." + t.Table }

func unsafeSprintf(t tbl) string { return fmt.Sprintf("SELECT %s FROM x", t.Name) }

func safe(t tbl) string { return "SELECT * FROM " + quoteIdent(t.Table) }
